title: Haaye Le Aaya Zamana Mere Aabid Ko Kaha'n
body:
HAYE SAJJAD HAAYE HAAYE SAJJAD (4)
Paaon me hai bediya'n gardan me hai tauqe garaa'n
Haaye le aaya zamana (2)mere aabid ko kaha'n
1)Har qadam taaza jafaye har qadam par aafatein...(2)
Ahle bait e mustufa ka (2) qafla hai ye rawaa'n
Paaon me hai bediya'n gardan me hai tauqe garaa'n (2)
2)Pushte naaka par bandhi hai dukhtare shahe huda..(2)
Uth rahi hai arshe aazam(2) se sadaye alamaa'n
Paaon me hai bediya'n gardan me hai tauqe garaa'n (2)
3)Ek qaidi hai jo raaho'n me mehwe bandagi...(2)
Taziyaano ki aziyat (2) khoon zakhmo se rawaa'n
Paaon me hai bediya'n gardan me hai tauqe garaa'n (2)
4)Haaaaaye.....
Chaar saala shaahzadi ab kise aawaz de...(2)
Cheenta hai shimr bedardi se jiski baaliyaa'n
Paaon me hai bediya'n gardan me hai tauqe garaa'n (2)
5)Ek rasan baara gale mushkil safar hai shaam tak...(2)
Khoon rokar keh rahi hai (2) fatema ki betiyaa'n
Paaon me hai bediya'n gardan me hai tauqe garaa'n (2)
6)Taziyane kalma go lekar khade hai chaar soo..(2)
Ek beemare hazee'n (2) rota hai leke hichkiyaa'n
Paaon me hai bediya'n gardan me hai tauqe garaa'n (2)
6)Haaaaaye.....
Jaane kya aanchal me hai baandhe hue umme rabab...(2)
Aisa lagta hai jale jhule ki hai kuch lakdiyaa'n
Paaon me hai bediya'n gardan me hai tauqe garaa'n (2)
7)Sham ke bazar me naa mehramo ka hai hujoom...(2)
Parda baalo se kiye hai (2) mustufa ki betaiyaa'n
Paao me hai bediya'n gardan me hai tauqe garaa'n (2)
8)Nauhakhwaa'n "IMRAN" hai matam kuna "REHAN" hai...(2)
Aur masaeb ho rahe hai (2) aale ahmed k bayaa'n
Paao me hai bediya'n gardan me hai tauqe garaa'n (2)
